title: Justification
definition: Justification is God’s gracious legal declaration that a sinner is righteous before Him through faith in Jesus Christ, based on Christ’s righteousness and atoning work.
summary: Justification is not God pretending sinners are righteous; it rests on the real obedience, blood, and righteousness of Christ credited to the believer.
christFocus: The believer stands accepted in Christ alone. There is no condemnation for those who are in Him because He has borne judgment and provides righteousness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Justification is by grace through faith, not works.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: It includes forgiveness and a righteous standing before God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Christ’s finished work is the ground of the believer’s peace.
